answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond for one serial-bound cedar-framed mirror as a public heliostat. It publishes its tilt log and delivered energy for a filing fee. A falcon auditor recomputes delivered energy from the tilt log and sun table; shortfall beyond 3%, a missing log, or a reused serial burns the bond. The first filing costs 36 credits; the kth per funder costs 36+9(k-1), so 1,000 fake identities pay 4,531,500 in fees plus 70,000 bonds. A rented-mirror ring fails: its serial is already bound. An honest identity pays 36 once and recovers its mirror bond after a clean epoch.
